placements.title: From crash to slug on missing identifiers
placements.theme: The derive-id pipeline must degrade gracefully when it encounters a heading without an id field, producing a valid slug rather than crashing.
placements.why: Both segments cohere around graceful degradation: src-1 reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from production, and src-2 states the behavioral contract — no crash, valid slug. This is a thematic subject future envelopes about the derive-id pipeline's resilience will continue to feed.
